Hi Mina —

Thanks for taking this — attached is our initial SIG export and a short evidence checklist. We need the completed SIG + primary evidence links by 2026-08-06 to satisfy our audit window.

High-level asks:
- Nominate section leads for the SIG (we prefer one primary + one backup per section).
- Provide proof artifacts (policies, config screenshots, SOC/RAS) as either a secure Drive folder or S3 presigned links; we can accept a short-term escrow if you prefer (details below).
- Indicate any sections you anticipate needing more time on (we can carve that out in the schedule).

Escrow options: FinWave can host a temporary encrypted deposit vault (we share credentials with designated owners) or you can provide a read-only Drive folder with per-file expiration. We will not store artifacts beyond 90 days unless agreed.

Attachment: FinWave_SIG_Request_20260720.pdf (PDF, 540 KB) — includes section mapping and baseline questions.

Please let me know who you nominate and whether Redwood will use Drive or S3 for evidence. Happy to jump on a quick 30-min sync this week if helpful.

Thanks,

Team — forwarding FinWave's SIG request. Deadline they asked for: 2026-08-06.

Proposed approach (quick):
1) Owner nomination: I suggest we nominate primary owners for the high-risk sections first (Access Control, Data Protection, Incident Mgmt, Third-party Management). Others can be split across teams.
2) Evidence escrow: Recommend we offer a read-only Google Drive folder with file-level expirations; easier for non-technical reviewers. If sensitive keys/configs are required we use an S3 presigned link and mark those files for short TTL.
3) Schedule: aim for internal draft by 2026-08-02, internal review 08-03 — 08-04, final deliverable 08-05 so we have a buffer.

Initial section nominations (please reply with confirm / swap / volunteer):
- Access Control (SIG: A.1, A.2): Marissa Cole (primary), Priyom Das (backup)
- Asset Management: Karthik Iyer (primary)
- Data Protection (encryption, key mgmt): Mina Haddad (primary)
- Incident Management & Monitoring: open — volunteers?
- Third-party Vendor Mgmt: Marissa Cole (primary)

Attachments: FinWave_SIG_Request_20260720.pdf (from Olivia) — already attached; also attaching our Access Control policy for reference.

Please add your preferred evidence storage method in your reply and list any known gaps. If you cannot take a section, suggest someone.

Thanks — Mina
